intro: Dana, leads from your website and Google listing are going cold because nobody calls back for a day or two, and with your crew on roofs all day most calls hit voicemail. You also can't tell which jobs come from Google, referrals or door-knocking. This scope makes sure every caller and every inquiry gets an answer within minutes, and puts your leads, estimates and revenue in one place.
scope: Missed-call text-back: an instant text to any caller you didn't pick up.
New-lead follow-up: automatic call, text and email in the first minutes and days after an inquiry.
Pipeline and reporting: one view of leads, estimates and revenue by source (Google, referrals, door-knocking).
terms: 50% due on acceptance, balance on delivery.
Phone, texting and email sending fees are billed at cost.
assumptions: You already have a Google Business Profile and a working website.
Two team members will use the system.
